name: Rose Grante
source:
Rose and Rence are fraternal twins. They live together with their father, although he is rarely able to be home with them. A dedicated businessman at an electronics company, he is usually overseas for important meetings.

Rose is often described by those around her as well-meaning, but ultimately hopeless. She tries her best at school, but always ends up falling asleep during classes. Her teachers wonder if she is afflicted with Narcolepsy, but both her and her father firmly deny it.

Rose is fairly clumsy as well, frequently bumping into people, falling over, or zoning out and dropping her books.
